Nornickel home page. It has no text about this pipeline.

ConsultantPlus copy of the federal list of trunk gas lines planned for siting. The current text has no Pelyatka to Messoyakha line and no 1.8 billion cubic meters figure, so it does not support the capacity.
Dudinka general plan PDF of 2017. It lists a Pelyatka, Nosok and Dudinka gas distribution line of 190 km. It states no 62 km or 117 km length for a Pelyatka to Messoyakha line.

Neftegaz.ru item of 6 May 2016 on the first start-up complex of the Pelyatka field to Dudinka gas and condensate lines. It gives 45 km of pipes and about 20 km of river crossings. That is a different line from the Pelyatka to Messoyakha trunk, so it gives no value for this row.
